rules.description: Pre-auth low threshold; origin lock and client 429 acceptance required
rules.expression: (not (http.host in {"finance.tuturuuu.com" "finance-staging.tuturuuu.com"}) and http.host in {"colab.tuturuuu.com" "hive.tuturuuu.com" "lettin.tuturuuu.com" "meet.tuturuuu.com" "parley.tuturuuu.com"} and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/auth/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/auth/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/cli/auth/")) and not (http.request.uri.path in {"/api/auth/refresh-app-session" "/api/auth/verify-app-token" "/api/v1/auth/cross-app-session/refresh" "/api/v1/auth/cross-app-token/verify" "/api/v1/auth/mfa/mobile/approvals"} or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/v1/auth/qr-login/challenges/")))
